description: The restrictions came into force from 10 p.m. on November 9 and will remain in effect until 9 p.m. on November 12, during which time all regular traffic through the construction route will be completely barred.

title: After Karnataka's E20 shocker, Keralam collects petrol samples to check ethanol content
description: Keralam has started collecting petrol samples to test ethanol levels following concerns raised by Karnataka. The state, represented by Minister Anoop Jacob, emphasized consumer rights regarding fuel quality. Inspections have occurred at fuel stations in Kochi, with samples sent for laboratory analysis. Karnataka reported excess ethanol levels in some petrol sold, raising concerns over potential vehicle damage. The Ministry of Petroleum stated that all tested samples had met quality standards.

title: Nvidia shares plunge 8% amid probe into CEO Huang's affair with 'Chinese spy'
description: Nvidia said an independent committee of its directors would supervise the investigation, with assistance from external independent legal counsel. It was reported last month that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, had developed a close relationship with the Nvidia chief and allegedly passed information directly to Beijing.

title: Your meal cost is set to rise: Eggs and chicken prices may rise 25-30% by December
description: Wholesale egg prices, currently hovering at Rs 6-7 per egg, are projected to climb to Rs 7-8 by December. The wholesale rate of dressed chicken without skin is also expected to rise from the current Rs 225-250 per kg to Rs 260-275 per kg over the same period, according to senior industry executives.

title: Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart to receive first joint philanthropy award
Old North Carolina iron mine now shelters five bat species; 320 acres protected
description: A former iron mine in North Carolina, which operated from the 1820s to the 1930s, now provides a winter shelter for five bat species, including rare and endangered ones. The Southern Appalachian Highlands Conservancy has purchased 320 acres around the historic mine to protect its underground tunnels, recovering forest and wildlife habitat. The move strengthens earlier conservation efforts to safeguard bats from habitat disturbance and white-nose syndrome, a deadly fungal disease.

title: Smriti Mandhana to lead India across all three formats on South Africa tour
description: Smriti Mandhana will captain India across all three formats on their December tour of South Africa, featuring one Test, three ODIs and three T20Is. Deepti Sharma will be vice-captain in Tests and ODIs, while Shafali Verma will deputise in T20Is. Vaishnavi Sharma replaces Sneh Rana in the ODI squad, while three young players feature in T20Is.

title: AI race sparks unusual scramble for ageing turbines, jet engines
description: The escalating electricity demands from AI companies are straining conventional power infrastructure, crucial for data centres that operate continuously. This shortfall can hinder project timelines, prompting firms to explore on-site electricity solutions. Gas turbines have emerged as a favored choice, driving up the desirability of second-hand options amidst a shortage of new units, presenting refurbished alternatives at more affordable rates.

title: PM Modi speaks with Zelenskyy, discusses efforts for Russia-Ukraine peace deal
In his memoir, Biden says Jan 6 Capitol attack will follow Trump to his grave
PT Usha loses; Saina, Anju, among four, come through in six-way IOA SOM Elections
description: PT Usha has lost the IOA Sportspersons of Outstanding Merit elections, ending her hopes of contesting for a second term as president. Saina Nehwal, Rani Rampal, Anju Bobby George and Dola Banerjee were elected among women, while four male athletes were chosen unopposed. The elected members are now eligible to contest the December 5 IOA elections.

title: Louisiana landowners lose pipeline canal damage case as lawsuit filed too late
description: Two Louisiana lumber companies have lost their legal battle against a gas company over canals they said had widened and damaged their land. The appeals court upheld the dismissal of their 2018 lawsuit, ruling that the companies had waited too long to take legal action. One judge disagreed, saying the case should have been examined further.

title: Neutral no more? Switzerland to vote on weapons export to conflict-hit countries
description: On November 29, Switzerland will vote on a pivotal referendum regarding arms exports to 36 western nations. This proposed legislation aims to relax current restrictions, which could greatly influence the defense sector. Advocates argue that enhancing arms exports is crucial for strengthening Switzerland's defense industry against escalating global threats, while critics caution that such changes could jeopardize the nation's historic neutrality.

title: Laser weapon to shoot down drones at low cost: How close is India to deploying it?
description: India has showcased significant advancements in its Directed-Energy Weapon programme focused on drone countermeasures. The Defence Research and Development Organisation has developed vehicle-mounted laser systems intended to engage aerial threats effectively. Various laser systems are at different developmental stages, with production partnerships being established. The challenges faced include environmental factors impacting laser effectiveness and operational viability in hostile conditions.

title: SMAT: SKY named Mumbai captain; Shardul returns from finger injury
description: The Mumbai Cricket Association has appointed Suryakumar Yadav as captain for the upcoming Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy. SKY will aim to regain his place in the Indian team with strong performances. Shardul Thakur returns after recovering from a finger fracture, while Shivam Dube features in the squad. Suryansh Shedge and Tanush Kotian will miss the tournament due to India A duty.

title: Canada hits Russia with fresh sanctions targeting missile tech, cyber networks
'I warned you': Kejriwal takes swipe at CM Yogi over SIR, congratulates Akhilesh
Israeli arms maker strikes Dutch deal to manufacture rifles, machine guns in Europe
description: The Netherlands is forging a strategic alliance with Israel Weapon Industries and Artillerie Inrichtingen Armaments to enhance its domestic defense production. This initiative will see the assembly of the ARAD 5 rifle and NEGEV UX machine gun taking place in Tilburg. With Israel Weapon Industries supplying essential technology and expertise, this move addresses the urgent need for proficient local manufacturing prompted by evolving geopolitical tensions in Europe.

title: 'Why spend on R&D?' Chandrasekhar mocks China's 'easier way' over Nvidia spy claim
description: Rajeev Chandrasekhar highlighted the recent honeytrapping allegations against Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang involving China. He criticised China's ethical standards in technology acquisition and alleged espionage practices. China responded by denying these allegations and labeling them as baseless. An independent investigation has been launched by Nvidia's board regarding the claims. Huang has also admitted to personal issues but maintains no national security breaches occurred.

title: Blackouts and no heating: Russia’s winter strike campaign takes aim at Ukraine’s energy network
description: Russia has commenced a significant campaign of missile and drone strikes against Ukraine's energy facilities, leading to power outages. Ukrainian officials reported large-scale damage in multiple regions, leaving many without electricity or heating. Ukraine is responding by targeting Russian missile launch sites to diminish their capabilities. Despite Ukrainian efforts, Russian forces continue their offensive operations, and logistics remain a hurdle for them.

title: Delhi pollution mystery: 36 monitoring stations 'go offline' as smoke engulfs Capital
description: This Diwali, Delhi faced its highest air pollution levels in five years, sparking doubts about the accuracy of monitoring systems. Numerous air quality stations ceased reporting at critical times, creating gaps in data. In contrast, private monitoring agencies discovered far greater pollution levels than the government reported, prompting accusations of data manipulation. Reliable air quality information is vital for ensuring public health, especially during pollution crises.

title: Territorial disputes to Nato: Key issues on Russia-Ukraine Abu Dhabi talks agenda
In 2019, Patrick Mahomes bought a $1.9M home his family outgrew in four years
description: Back in February 2019, Patrick Mahomes acquired a ranch-style home in Kansas City for around $1.9 million. Fast forward four years, and he decided to sell the home for $2.9 million in July 2023. With a stylish sneaker closet and completed renovations, the house still felt cramped for his expanding family, prompting Mahomes to start building a new, tailored home south of the city.

title: Megaspeed responds to chip smuggling claims amid Jensen Huang affair investigation
description: Megaspeed, a leading AI infrastructure firm based in Singapore, firmly rebuts accusations of unauthorized chip transfers to China, claiming these allegations are unfounded. Investigations by multiple agencies have cleared their name. Recently, buzz surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's personal life has drawn renewed scrutiny towards Megaspeed. Nevertheless, the company upholds its commitment to legal and ethical practices, hinting at possible legal action against Bloomberg for what they call misleading reports.

title: Gang posing as Army suppliers dupe Assam firm of Rs 11.5 crore, key accused held
'Sound of sickles louder than crackers on Diwali’: Oppn slams TN govt over murders
description: The leaders cited the murders of a special sub-inspector of police in Theni district and 10 others, including a 19-year-old youth in Chennai's Vyasarpadi, on Diwali day.

title: 'What justice is it to send KL Rahul at No.6?': Ex-India selector raises question
description: KL Rahul’s batting position sparked debate after India’s second ODI against New Zealand, as Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticised sending Axar Patel ahead of him. Axar managed just seven runs, while Rahul looked comfortable. Srikkanth called it unfair to Rahul, but Sunil Gavaskar defended the move, explaining that promoting a left-hander can disrupt bowlers’ rhythm.

title: Iran wants Putin's S-400 shield, but Russia has a war of its own to fight
description: As Russia and Iran enhance their military collaboration, discussions around air defense systems, particularly the S-400, are intensifying. While Iran eagerly anticipates the acquisition to secure its borders, Russia is cautious about fulfilling this request, needing the S-400 for its own defense amidst the conflict in Ukraine. Complicated by foreign technology dependencies, any potential transfer to Iran could experience significant delays.

title: Indian-origin woman shot dead at London home, man charged with murder
Pakistani TV anchor Rabia Ahsan shot dead at home; husband detained
Couple dies as Himachal car dealer rams SUV into neighbours over firecracker dispute
description: In Badoli village, a couple was killed after their neighbor, Jarnail Singh, ran them over with his SUV. The incident occurred following an argument about bursting firecrackers during Diwali celebrations. Onkar Singh and his wife, Veena Devi, died from severe injuries after being struck by the vehicle. The police have registered a murder case against Jarnail Singh, who also sustained injuries during the altercation.

title: Trump seeks exit, Iran defiant: Key issues holding up peace deal as Qatar brokers talks
description: Negotiations between the United States and Iran are being facilitated by Qatar amidst ongoing conflict. Washington seeks to regulate Iran's nuclear capabilities and ensure access to the Strait of Hormuz. Iran demands the lifting of sanctions and recognition of its strategic interests in any agreement. Despite diplomatic efforts, significant divisions remain regarding nuclear concessions and economic relief. Both sides face internal pressures complicating the path to a resolution.

title: Iran’s hidden oil network in China: Leaked letter details Tehran’s strategy
Chinese vloggers pass off Bangladesh slums as India in bizarre videos
'He called us Naxals': Rahul Gandhi hits back at PM Modi, renews debate challenge
'Baseless smear campaign': China denies spying charge targeting Nvidia CEO
description: China has rejected allegations of espionage involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, labeling them as a smear campaign. Foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated that these claims are unfounded and baseless. Nvidia's board has initiated an independent investigation into reports of a foreign intelligence operation. The investigation involves Alice Huang, a former executive accused of being linked to China's Ministry of State Security.

title: Delhi records most polluted Diwali in 5 years
description: Delhi's air quality recorded a significant deterioration during Diwali, reaching an average AQI of 376. Major monitoring stations reported severe pollution, with 14 categorized as severe. Visibility was severely affected early Monday due to dense fog and smog covering the city. Firecracker usage persisted beyond permitted times despite restrictions, worsening pollution levels. The Air Quality Early Warning System forecasts that unhealthy air quality conditions may continue in the coming days.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's spy row puts spotlight on scandals that cost CEOs their jobs
Rejected a job offer for chess, now he's India's 100th GM: How Anuj Shrivatri made it
description: Anuj Shrivatri has made history by becoming India's 100th Grandmaster while competing in the Philippines. His journey, which began in childhood under the influence of his father's fascination with chess, had seen multiple unsuccessful attempts before this triumph. As he celebrates this remarkable milestone, Shrivatri is committed to honing his skills and aims to dominate in more chess tournaments.

title: TN SSI dies after scuffle with youngsters bursting crackers
description: A special sub-inspector named Senthil Kumar died following an altercation with a group of youngsters. He confronted them while they were bursting crackers on a public road, which caused public inconvenience. During the encounter, one youth allegedly struck him, resulting in his collapse. Police rushed him to a hospital, but he later succumbed to his injuries. Authorities have arrested three individuals linked to the incident for further investigation.

title: 'No passport to terrorist': Dhaka rejects Sheikh Hasina's plea for return
description: Sheikh Hasina has applied for a new passport and national identity card, indicating her intent to return and address the legal matters awaiting her in Bangladesh. Despite a prior ban, her Awami League party continues to enjoy robust support. Her return is likely to heighten the existing political unrest and may further complicate India-Bangladesh relations, as discussions on her extradition unfold.

title: Travis Kelce's heartfelt gesture for Jody Fortson reveals their special bond
description: Jody Fortson expressed sincere appreciation for the invaluable mentorship he received from Travis Kelce, which he credits for enhancing his understanding of route-running and football strategies. Fortson fondly recalled his visits to Kelce's home, where he learned not just about the game but also about preparation techniques from Chiefs head coach Andy Reid. In March 2024, Fortson signed with the Miami Dolphins, ready to implement those lessons.

title: 4 days after being brought back, Buxa tigress digs tunnel & flees again
description: A three-year-old tigress recently brought to Buxa escaped from her acclimatisation enclosure by digging a hole. This incident occurred shortly after her return from a capture operation in Assam’s Raimona landscape. The escape raises concerns about the enclosure’s security and the challenges of containing a wild tigress. Previously, this tigress had also escaped within days of her initial release in October.

title: Parth meets Sharad Pawar twice in 2 days, NCP leaders seek to revive merger talks
description: Parth Pawar met Sharad Pawar for two consecutive days, raising speculation about a potential merger of NCP factions. Many senior leaders expressed discontent with how key decisions were made recently without their consultation. Meetings with Union home minister Amit Shah sparked additional concerns about intra-party disagreements within the NCP. Praful Patel announced he would meet Sharad Pawar after November 10 to discuss party matters.

title: Microsoft employees call work ‘joyless’ in open letter as 60,000 get buyout offers
description: Microsoft employees are circulating an open letter accusing the company of pursuing AI at all costs, saying work there has become "joyless and demoralizing." The letter is gaining attention after Microsoft offered buyouts to 60,000 employees across India, the US, UK and Canada, its largest ever. It flags forced AI use, layoffs, data centres and climate goals, as staff report raises below 1% while Microsoft posts a 32% profit jump.
